verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
verses.translation: Say: “I seek refuge with the Lord of the rising day;
from the evil of all that He created;
from the evil of night's darkness when it spreads around;
from the evil of the women who blow on knots;
and from the evil of the envier when he envies.”
